comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Generic and specialty prescription drug maker selling to pharmacies and wholesalers; Bioventus sells devices and biologics to surgeons.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Generic injectables, inhalers and diagnostic kits for hospitals and pharmacies; a drug business, not orthopedic devices or biologics.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Rare genetic disease therapies sold to specialist physicians; no overlap with Bioventus's orthopedic devices and biologics.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Heart valves and hemodynamic monitoring sold to cardiac surgeons; different products and clinical customers from orthopedics.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Dental implants, aligners and consumables sold to dentists; shares implant manufacturing but serves a different clinical market.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: IV infusion systems and injectable drugs for hospitals; no overlap with orthopedic bone healing, pain devices or cartilage products.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Opioid use disorder buprenorphine medicines sold to pharmacies and clinics; a pharmaceutical business unrelated to Bioventus.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Surgical device and implant maker selling orthopedic implants and regenerative matrices to surgeons, though neurosurgery is its main focus.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Radiopharmaceutical diagnostic imaging agents and generators for imaging centers; a different product and customer base.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Disposable interventional catheters and guidewires for cardiology and radiology; minimally invasive devices outside orthopedics.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Skin substitutes for chronic wound care sold to wound centers; regenerative biologics but a different indication and customer base.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Non-opioid pain products for surgery and orthopedics, including a knee pain injection, sold to surgeons and surgical centers.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Diversified mix of medical products, dental solutions and health IT software and services; not a focused orthopedic device business.

comps.label: C14
comps.reason: Pneumatic compression devices for lymphedema and venous disease, mostly rented to patients; different therapy area and channel.

comps.label: C15
comps.reason: Broad hospital device maker in vascular access, anesthesia and urology; lacks orthopedic biologics, bone healing or pain device lines.

comps.label: C16
comps.reason: Spine implants, bone graft substitutes and orthobiologics sold to spine surgeons, closely matching Bioventus's bone graft and surgeon customers.
